prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: a polished square plugin icon for QuickStark's QS Video Editor, used in Codex plugin listings and command menus. Primary request: design one original, premium, minimal logo that combines a bold QS monogram with the visual language of precise video editing. Build a compact geometric mark: the Q reads as a video frame with a play-shaped negative space or a deliberate cut, while an elegant S-like cut joins the forms. Make the letters QS legible without adding a separate wordmark. Style: clean vector-like flat graphic, strong silhouette, generous clear margins, carefully balanced optical weight, professional editorial studio identity. Use a dark ink rounded-square tile with a restrained vivid teal accent in the mark, and a genuinely transparent canvas outside the tile. It must remain identifiable as a tiny app icon on both light and dark backgrounds. Composition: one centered icon filling about 80 percent of the square, no multi-panel presentation or mockup. Text, if visible, is exactly QS, integrated in the symbol. Avoid hairline details, film-reel clichés, ornamental clapperboards, tiny text, gradients, glow, 3D bevels, stock watermarks, and existing company logos. Deliver the finished logo artwork only.
